description.p: Veronica replaces a shelf of single-purpose utilities with one native application. It tracks coding-agent usage and alerts on rate limits, monitors this machine and your SSH hosts, controls media and audio, keeps a clipboard and colour-swatch history, blurs sensitive figures while you share your screen, dims everything behind the window you are working in, and puts Veronica's own shelf in the top bar.
Usage data never leaves the machine. There is no account and no telemetry.

Adds rate-limit alerts, the colour picker with a swatch history, presenter mode with automatic screen-share detection, Focus Dim, and a CPU and memory readout beside the top bar clock. Makes the clipboard history reachable from the app, and reports a capability Veronica has not built as such rather than as available.
Adds a synchronized Claude/Codex limit switcher and six shared app/notch appearance themes.
Fixes webcam capability negotiation and makes the five Edith quick actions functional from both the notch and desktop app.
Adds a privacy-scoped live camera preview inside the notch, corrects Home layout sizing, and refines the active-tab capsule.
Removes the notch halo and replaces the overshooting popup transition with a flicker-free two-layer macOS-style surface morph.
Adds fully rounded Dynamic-Island-style motion and functional file shelf, keyboard cleaning, presenter privacy, color picker, and camera actions.
Uses the compact Edith-style center notch, preserves Ubuntu Quick Settings, and removes the separate usage indicator and injected calendar sections.
First release: agent usage dashboard, system monitor, the notch island and the vr CLI.
